title: Chipmaker unveils low-power inference accelerator for edge devices
summary: The new part targets cameras and industrial sensors, promising on-device language model inference at under five watts. Shipments to partners begin next quarter.

title: City council approves pilot for autonomous shuttle buses
summary: Three electric shuttles will run a fixed downtown loop for twelve months. Safety drivers stay on board during the first phase while regulators review incident data.

title: Open-source database project reaches 10.0 with rewritten query planner
summary: Maintainers say the new planner cuts median query latency by a third on analytical workloads. The release also drops support for two legacy storage engines.

title: Retailer discloses breach of loyalty-program database
summary: Names, email addresses and point balances for about 2 million members were exposed through a misconfigured API. Payment data was not affected, the company said.

title: Researchers demonstrate room-temperature quantum memory prototype
summary: The team stored a quantum state for 40 milliseconds without cryogenic cooling. Independent groups have not yet replicated the result.

title: Cloud provider cuts egress prices in three regions
summary: Data transfer out to the internet drops by up to 30 percent starting next month. Analysts see the move as a response to pressure from EU regulators.

title: Smartphone maker delays flagship launch over display supply
summary: The company pushed its launch event back six weeks after a key supplier reported yield problems with a new folding panel.

title: Regulators publish draft rules for AI model transparency
summary: Providers of large models would have to document training data sources and publish evaluation results. Public comment is open for 60 days.

title: Space agency confirms water ice deposits near lunar south pole
summary: Orbital radar and a rover's neutron spectrometer both point to ice within a metre of the surface, a boost for plans to produce fuel on the Moon.

title: Popular JavaScript package hijacked, malicious versions pulled
summary: Attackers published two versions that stole environment variables after taking over a maintainer account. The registry removed them within four hours.

title: Enterprise software firm to acquire observability startup
summary: The all-stock deal values the startup at about 1.2 billion dollars and folds its tracing product into the buyer's monitoring suite.

title: Battery recycler opens plant able to recover 95 percent of lithium
summary: The facility can process 20,000 tonnes of spent cells a year and will supply recovered material to two carmakers under long-term contracts.
